name: Can I flush my water heater myself, or should I hire a professional?

mainEntity.name: Can I flush my water heater myself, or should I hire a professional?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it is possible for some homeowners to perform a water heater flush, it's generally recommended to hire a professional, especially if you're not experienced with plumbing tasks. Incorrectly flushing the unit can lead to leaks, damage, or even a lack of hot water. A professional plumber will have the right tools and knowledge to safely and effectively remove sediment, inspect the anode rod, and check for other potential issues. CG Plumbing Solutions technicians are equipped to handle this service efficiently for residents in areas like Henderson and Summerlin.
acceptedAnswer.description: While DIY flushing is possible, hiring a professional plumber is recommended to ensure the job is done correctly and safely, preventing potential damage.
